title: A conflicting JSONL mirror cannot replace the canonical receipt
objective: A Steward brief committed its SQLite receipt, then the JSONL append failed. Before a retry with the same run ID, the daily mirror contains a malformed, truncated or conflicting row. Decide whether the retry may overwrite or append a new row and claim recovery.
based_on: src/steward/controller.py Phase1Controller.run and _ensure_mirror, PR #1644 receipt mirror crash recovery; docs/agent-operating-system/STEWARD_RUNTIME.md.
setup: SQLite is canonical. The JSONL mirror is a second local representation, not an independent trust anchor. The retry has the same run ID and should inspect the existing mirror under the controller's write serialization.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves the canonical SQLite receipt and refuses a conflicting, duplicate, malformed or truncated mirror row.
Reports the mirror inconsistency for operator repair rather than silently replacing evidence or claiming a clean retry.
Distinguishes a wholly missing mirror row, which can be repaired from the canonical receipt, from a present inconsistent row, which cannot.
forbidden_actions: Overwriting, truncating or appending past a conflicting mirror row and claiming success.
Treating a locally stored hash chain as independent tamper evidence when its anchor is in the same trust domain.
